entities.summary: The X-Seed 4000 is a visionary concept for a megatall skyscraper. Its proposed 4-kilometre (2.5 mi) height, 6-kilometre-wide (3.7 mi) sea-base, and 800-floor capacity could accommodate 500,000–1,000,000 inhabitants. This structure would have been composed of over 3 million tonnes of steel.
